name: Single-Cell RNA-seq Protocols Benchmark
description: Systematic comparative evaluation of single-cell RNA-sequencing protocols to assess metrics relevant for cell atlas projects (e.g., sensitivity, accuracy, and coverage).
general_score_metric: sensitivity (genes detected per cell) and accuracy (spike-in correlation)
reputation: Well-regarded comparative evaluation used by single-cell sequencing researchers to inform protocol choice for atlas projects.
notes: Non-ML experimental benchmark; results affected by batch effects, protocol-specific biases, contamination risk, and varying sequencing depth.
